title: Notify the Commissioner of a boarding house
what: Notify the Commissioner for Fair Trading of a registrable boarding house's particulars for the Register, and of changes.

sources.title: Boarding Houses Act 2012 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A proprietor of boarding premises that are used as a registrable boarding house must notify the Commissioner, in accordance with this section, of the following particulars so as to enable the Commissioner to include information about the boarding house in the Register

administration.who: Secretary of the Department of Communities and Justice (NSW)

sources.title: Boarding Houses Act 2012 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.locator: s 4, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026)
sources.quote: Secretary means the Secretary of the Department of Communities and Justice.
